_comment: Which Undead Legacy build every launcher installs. Fetched at install time,
so bumping the mod reaches everyone without reissuing the app.
7 Days to Die refuses connections between a client and server on different
mod builds, so this file and the server MUST be updated together:
1. update the server  (server/setup-ul-server.sh reads this same file)
2. commit this file   (clients pick it up on their next install)
Doing it the other way round sends players to a build the server isn't on.
sha          = the GitLab commit to install. 40 hex chars.
mirrorSha256 = SHA-256 of the copy on the private mirror, if it holds one.
Omit it and the mirror simply isn't offered for that part.
It cannot describe a GitLab download: those archives are
generated per request and are not byte-reproducible.
Anything malformed here is ignored and the launcher falls back to the pins
compiled into the app, so a bad edit degrades rather than breaks.
